---
description:
  Checks that a subgraph can declare its own layout direction independent of the
  parent flowchart's direction, and that dagre lays out the nested subgraph
  accordingly.
config:
  layout: dagre
  htmlLabels: true
  flowchart:
    htmlLabels: true
  securityLevel: loose
---
flowchart LR

  subgraph TOP
  direction TB
  subgraph B1
      direction RL
      i1 -->f1
  end
  subgraph B2
      direction BT
      i2 -->f2
  end
  end
  A --> TOP --> B
  B1 --> B2

description:
  Exercises many flowchart edge syntax variants together (differing dash/dot
  counts, bidirectional arrows, thick and dotted lines, and both prefix- and
  infix-style labels), checking that dagre lays out edges of varying rendered
  length correctly.
config:
  layout: dagre
---
flowchart TD
  L1 --- L2
  L2 --- C
  M1 ---> C
  R1 .-> R2
  R2 <.-> C
  C -->|Label 1| E1
  C <-- Label 2 ---> E2
  C ----> E3
  C <-...-> E4
  C ======> E5

  subgraph to a node declared only outside it, checking that dagre routes both
  unambiguously.

  htmlLabels: true

  subgraph sub_one[Sub One]
  _sub_one
  end
  subgraph sub_two[Sub Two]
  _sub_two
  end
  _one
  end

  %% here, either the first or the second one
